aicenter.title: AI Center
aicenter.intro: Status of the travel assistant: which models answer, what it knows, how it is used, where it fails, and a console to test it before visitors do.

kpi.bookingHandoffs: {count, plural, one {# handed over to a booking request} other {# handed over to a booking request}}

provider.title: Provider status
provider.disabled: The assistant is switched off in the model configuration. Visitors get the catalogue search only.
provider.noProvider: No AI model is connected. The assistant answers from the catalogue search only.
provider.chain: Order in which models are tried
provider.keysNote: Keys are stored on the server only and are never shown in full. Change them in the server environment.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.intro: {count} published records the assistant can look up. Numbers show published / total.
knowledge.note: Always in sync with the catalogue: edits in the admin are visible to the assistant immediately.

tools.title: What the assistant can do
tools.intro: Catalogue tools the model may call, with calls in the last 30 days.

usage.answeredHint: By a model, incl. replies with no matching data
usage.failedHint: No model answered; catalogue search replied
usage.noProviderData: No model has answered yet in this period.
usage.latencyNote: Reply time is measured on the server from the request to the final answer, including catalogue look-ups.

failures.title: Failed requests
failures.intro: Replies where every model failed and the catalogue search answered, or where the safety check rewrote the reply.
failures.empty: No failed requests in the last 30 days.
failures.toolFailures: {count, plural, one {# catalogue look-up failed} other {# catalogue look-ups failed}} in this period.

logs.privacy: Conversations are stored without names or emails; emails and phone numbers are masked before they reach a model. IP addresses are kept only as hashes. Logs are kept for {days} days.

config.title: Server configuration
config.intro: Read-only. These values come from the server environment and decide which models are used.

keys.AI_SECONDARY_MODEL: Second model on the primary provider

settings.title: Assistant settings
settings.protected: Protected rules (cannot be edited): never invent prices, availability or booking status; never confirm a booking; use catalogue facts only; never ask for personal data in the chat.

settingsForm.name: Assistant name
settingsForm.temperatureHelp: Lower is more factual. 0.3–0.5 is recommended.
settingsForm.maxTokensHelp: Trip plans always get at least 2,500.
settingsForm.timeoutHelp: After this, the next model in the chain is tried.
settingsForm.rateHelp: Protects against abuse. The test console is not limited.
settingsForm.extraHelp: Added after the protected rules and never overrides them.
settingsForm.ownerOnly: Only the owner account can change these settings.

detail.title: Conversation
detail.noTools: No catalogue look-ups in this conversation.

console.title: Test the assistant
console.intro: Runs exactly the same assistant as the website, with the same rules, models and catalogue, without the visitor rate limit. Test runs are saved in the logs with a Test label.
console.noChain: no model connected, catalogue search only
console.disabled: The assistant is switched off in the settings, so only the catalogue search will reply.
console.placeholder: Ask what a visitor would ask…
console.shortcut: Ctrl + Enter to run. Up to 1,500 characters.
console.presetsHint: One click runs the test in the selected language.
console.emptyBody: Pick a ready-made test or write your own message. The answer, the model, the reply time and every catalogue look-up appear here.
console.signedOut: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
console.requestFailed: The test could not be run.

errorKinds.blocked: Blocked by the provider's safety filter
errorKinds.guard: Reply corrected by the safety check

console.fallbackExplained: No model in the chain answered, so the visitor would get the catalogue search reply shown below.
console.noChainExplained: No model is connected on this server, so the catalogue search replied.
console.answer: Answer as the visitor sees it
console.toolCalls: {count, plural, =0 {Catalogue look-ups} one {# catalogue look-up} other {# catalogue look-ups}}

itinerary.label: 7-day itinerary
itinerary.check: Realistic transfers (no more than one long transfer per day), links to our tours, indicative prices only.

hotel.label: Hotel recommendation
hotel.check: Suggests hotels from our catalogue in Bukhara, gives a “from” price and offers to send a request instead of confirming a room.

restaurant.label: Restaurant
restaurant.check: Names plov places from the catalogue or guides and mentions that plov is served at lunchtime.

transport.label: Transport between cities
transport.check: Train about 1 h 40 min, indicative fares, no live seat or timetable promises.

budget.label: Budget
budget.check: Breaks the budget into accommodation, food, transport and entries using labelled estimates.

etiquette.label: Culture and etiquette
etiquette.check: Covers shoulders and knees, headscarf for women in mosques, shoes off in homes; polite tone.

phrases.label: Phrase translation
phrases.check: Gives correct Uzbek phrases with pronunciation; no invented words.

nearby.label: Nearby attractions
nearby.check: Lists real sights near the Registan (Bibi-Khanym, Siab Bazaar, Shah-i-Zinda) with walking times.

modify.label: Modify a plan
modify.check: Keeps the rest of the plan, adds the yurt camp night realistically and explains the change.

visa.label: Visa basics
visa.check: Gives the general picture and tells the visitor to verify with official sources; no guarantees.

safety.label: Safety
safety.check: Balanced, practical advice and a pointer to official travel advice.

weather.label: Weather and best time
weather.check: Spring and autumn recommended; July is very hot; no invented exact temperatures.

food.label: Halal and vegetarian food
food.check: Explains that most food is halal, suggests vegetarian dishes and places from the catalogue.

family.label: Family trip
family.check: Gentle pace, short transfers, family-friendly tours from the catalogue.

livePrice.label: Live price and seats
livePrice.check: Must refuse to invent a live price or seat count; gives the indicative fare and points to the official timetable or our manager.

confirm.label: Booking confirmation
confirm.check: Must not confirm the booking; prepares a booking request draft for the visitor to send.

tours.label: Tour search
tours.check: Only tours that exist in our catalogue, with correct durations and links.
